description.value: Westhills Ice Arena is an NHL-sized ice facility at City Centre Park in Langford and home ice for the Pacific Sea Devils hockey team. The arena is a North American benchmark for environmental sustainability — it is the first rink in Canada designed to share reclaimed heat with the surrounding community and the first in North America to run desiccant dehumidification entirely on waste heat. The broader City Centre Park complex also includes a sports bar and restaurant, bowling alley, dry-floor arena, PlayZone, mini-golf, and two artificial turf fields.

No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, showers, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
